title: Mobile/touch: right Library/Properties pane obscures content & can't be resized on narrow viewports
description:
## Repro (mobile/narrow viewport)
On a narrow/mobile viewport, the right pane (Library/Properties tabs) took a fixed 240px non-shrinking slice; it overlapped/squeezed the stage and could not be collapsed or resized by touch.

## Root cause
1. styles.rightPanel had width:"240px", flexShrink:0 in the centerRegion flex row, with NO @media/matchMedia responsive collapse anywhere. On narrow viewports the 240px pane ate the width and squeezed the stage column.
2. useResize wired only onMouseDown (document mousemove/mouseup), so the resize handle never started a drag on touch (right pane, timeline, and bottom dock all affected).

## Fix (task 1280)
- useResize -> Pointer Events: onPointerDown + document pointermove/pointerup/pointercancel + setPointerCapture + touch-action:none during drag. Also fixes touch-resize of the timeline and bottom dock (shared hook). Bound via onPointerDown on all three handles.
- Responsive right pane: new useIsNarrowViewport() matchMedia hook (breakpoint 720px) + rightPaneCollapsed UI state (uiStore). On desktop the pane is the SAME inline resizable column as before (verified width still 240px, data-narrow=false, resize handle present). On narrow it becomes a collapsible overlay drawer (position:absolute, right-anchored, box-shadow) with a tap-to-dismiss backdrop and a ☰ open toggle; it defaults collapsed on narrow (mount + breakpoint-cross sync, preserving a manual toggle within a mode). Stage is no longer squeezed.
- Structural/tab-agnostic: tab strip + pane content are identical in both modes; only the wrapper differs, so adding a future Agent tab needs no change here.

## Verification (reproducible)
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build => Done (all packages, green).
- pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run => 51 files / 706 tests passed (0 failures; no task-1207 fixture failures observed). Added src/__tests__/rightPaneResponsive.test.ts (9 tests) locking the render-mode predicates + breakpoint.
- Playwright headless against dev server (localhost:1420):
  - Narrow 600px: pane starts collapsed (open-toggle shown); toggle opens overlay drawer (data-narrow=true, right-anchored x=360 w=240, backdrop present); backdrop tap dismisses. RESULT: PASS.
  - Desktop 1280px: panel inline (data-narrow=false), resize handle present, no open-toggle, width=240. Layout unchanged. RESULT: PASS.

## Files
- packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx (useResize -> pointer events; useIsNarrowViewport + NARROW_VIEWPORT_BREAKPOINT; responsive overlay render; auto-collapse effect)
- packages/authoring-ui/src/store/uiStore.ts (rightPaneCollapsed state + setter)
- packages/authoring-ui/src/__tests__/rightPaneResponsive.test.ts (new)
